headline: Why Your Full Bathroom Renovation Might Be Taking Longer Than Expected
articleBody:
Starting a full bathroom renovation is exciting, but sometimes the timeline can feel like it's stretching out. It's not always just about the hands-on work; there are several moving parts that can affect how quickly your dream bathroom comes to life. Understanding these can help manage expectations and keep things smooth.

First, there's the initial planning and material selection. Before any demolition, you're making big decisions on fixtures, tiles, and layouts. Lead times for custom items or specific materials can add weeks, especially if you're looking for something unique. It's really important to finalize these choices early on, as changing your mind mid-project can cause significant delays.

Then, consider the permit and inspection process. In places like Berkeley and the wider East Bay Area, if you're moving plumbing, changing electrical, or altering structural elements, permits are often required. Each stage of work usually needs an inspection before the next can begin. A missed inspection or a need for rework can push the schedule back. A good contractor like Frasheski Construction will handle this, but it's part of the overall timeline.

Coordination of different trades also plays a huge role. From plumbers and electricians to tilers and painters, everyone needs to work together efficiently. If one trade finishes late, it impacts the start time of the next. That's why having a contractor who can manage all these aspects and keep the project moving is so valuable.

Finally, unforeseen issues can crop up once demolition starts. Hidden water damage, outdated wiring, or structural quirks are common in older homes. While a good contractor will anticipate some of this, unexpected discoveries can require additional work, materials, and sometimes even new permits, naturally extending the project duration.

What to Expect During the Process
A standard remodel can take around 20-30 working days once construction begins. However, the entire journey, including planning, material selection, and approvals, can extend to approximately six weeks to three months. Some larger projects might even span three to five months from your initial consultation through to completion. It’s a process, but the results are worth it.
